caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular arrangement of geometric patterns composed of repeated shapes and lines, rendered in a limited color palette of dark blue, off-white, and red. The central portion features a grid structure, with multiple columns and rows forming a symmetrical layout. Dominant elements include off-white diamond and cross-like shapes aligned horizontally and vertically against a dark blue background. Red square and rectangular blocks are interspersed throughout the pattern, appearing at various intervals and along the top and bottom edges, as well as within the grid. The left and lower sections of the design display linear and ladder-like motifs, primarily in dark blue and off-white, which contrast with the solid blocks and geometric patterns. The entire composition is set against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
